title: Yawmiyati country offer (one row of research/selection/offers.csv)
description: One row per COUNTRY-SPECIFIC offer. Built by research/scripts/select.py; workflow and rules in docs/PRODUCT-SELECTION.md. Unknown = empty cell plus a *_note / uncertainties entry, never 0.

rank.description: Rank within country by score_total; empty for existing 'reject' rows.

stage.description: candidate = from catalog rules only; researched = item-level competitor evidence attached; approved needs Rashid's yes; published needs the store catalog gate.

existing_status.description: Decision carried over from research/data/launch_assortment_v2.csv (launch, test, hold, reject, launch (optional add-on), launch (quantity option)); empty for new rows.

name_ar.description: Taager catalog title, verbatim (not customer copy).

taager_cost.description: Catalog original_price = Taager's price to the merchant.

taager_min_price.description: Catalog selling_price = Taager's minimum selling price.

proposed_price.description: Product price set in Taager (delivery not included).

customer_delivery_fee.description: Fee the customer pays Taager per order; Egypt zones 95/100/105.

customer_total.description: proposed_price + delivery fee (range for Egypt zones).

margin_per_delivery.description: Wallet profit if delivered and kept = price - cost - Saudi VAT on uplift.

other_fees.description: Refusal charge with status, return charge, payout fee, VAT.

stock_status.description: stock_range (detailed_stock) from the export; empty = not reported.

stock_checked_at.description: Export capture date is unknown (before 2026-10-28). The store gate needs a check < 48 h old.

variants.description: Other Taager variants of the same product_id, and deduped near-identical SKUs (alternates, identity not verified).

multi_unit_skus.description: Taager multi-unit SKUs of this product (structure c).

bundle_contents.description: Only what the Taager title says; contents unverified.

confirmation_rate_evidence.description: Sample size + date range. Empty: no order history.

competitor_comparisons.description: 'identical:' / 'similar:' from benchmarks_*_v2.csv (item level, with source) and 'similar-archetype' ranges (SIMILAR items, not identical).

score_operational_risk.description: Higher = riskier; enters the total inverted.

first_wave_pick.description: Rule W in docs/PRODUCT-SELECTION.md. A recommendation, not an approval.
